cases.label: Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_spot
cases.message: How do I recognise gray leaf spot on corn?
cases.expected: Lists only the symptoms of gray leaf spot of corn: long circular to elliptical, grayish green or tan lesions; concentric dark rings in moist weather; lower leaves affected first, then the disease moves up the plant; premature death resembling frost or drought injury. No cause or control measures. In English, with source.
